verdict: Leads steady at a low cost, but local visibility went dark this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 128 leads at $11.44 cost per lead — a solid baseline — with Meta carrying the full paid load. This past week, however, cost per lead rose 8.71% on nearly flat spend, a sign that ad efficiency is softening and worth watching. More urgently, your Google Business Profile went dark for three consecutive days (Aug 9–11), dropping local search actions 42% week-over-week; we are investigating and working to restore visibility now. Separately, 128 leads have entered your pipeline this period but zero appointments are showing as scheduled, which points to a gap in how leads are being followed up rather than any problem with the ads themselves — your team is reviewing the intake process. Expect a local search recovery update and a cleaner lead-to-appointment picture by next week's report.
